item.title: Ordering Materials at a Print Shop
item.description: Order a small print job, explain how you want it printed and finished, and check a trial copy before the shop prints the rest.

children.definition: Printed on only one side of each sheet.
children.example: Please make the feedback forms single-sided so people can use the other side for notes.

children.definition: Printed on both sides of each sheet.
children.example: Make the program two-sided so the map is on the back of the schedule.

children.definition: A standard size of paper that is 210 millimeters wide and 297 millimeters long.
children.example: Could you print the instructions on A4 so they fit in our folders?

children.definition: The total number of copies of one design or document that are printed at one time.
children.example: Could you give me a price for a print run of 60 flyers?

children.definition: A trial version made so you can check how the finished pages will look before the rest are printed.
children.example: Could I see a proof copy to check that the text is large enough before you print all 40 copies?

children.definition: A printed version that shows the different colors in the original.
children.example: I need one color copy of the floor plan so the blue and green areas are easy to tell apart.
collocations: a color copy of the original

children.definition: Printed in black, with or without shades of gray, and without any other colors.
children.example: The instructions are just text, so black-and-white printing is fine.

children.definition: To fasten sheets together with a small piece of metal that goes through them.
children.example: Please staple the three pages of each information pack in the top left corner.

children.definition: To bend a sheet along a line so that one part lies over another.
children.example: Could you fold each leaflet in half so the title is on the outside?

children.definition: To cover a printed sheet with a thin layer of clear plastic to protect it.
children.example: Could you laminate these price lists so we can wipe them clean at the counter?

children.definition: The blank space between the edge of a page and the printed area.
children.example: Please leave a wider left margin so we can punch holes without cutting into the text.

children.definition: The choice of whether a page is set up to be taller than it is wide or wider than it is tall.
children.example: Could you change the page orientation so the six columns fit across the sheet?

children.definition: Having a surface that does not shine under light.
children.example: I'd like matte paper for the posters because they'll hang under bright lights.

children.definition: To cut away a small amount from the edges to make something neat or the right size.
children.example: Could you trim the invitations to fit these envelopes?
